asked.item: Can Claude search the Inspiration database via the Blotato MCP server
How to search Inspiration for meal prep posts in the web app

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that the MCP tool catalog has no Inspiration Database search tool, and they describe the web-app search steps.

steps.text: The Blotato MCP tool catalog does not expose an Inspiration Database search tool, so Claude can't search Inspiration through the MCP server.
To search in the web app, open the navigation menu, expand Tools, and select Inspiration.
Use Search posts... to enter your topic.
